## createSequentialColorScale() function

A continuous color scale for a numeric metric (e.g. BLAST e-value/bit score/percent identity), as opposed to [createCategoricalColorScale()](./core.createcategoricalcolorscale.md)<!-- -->'s discrete category→color mapping. Linearly interpolates through RGB space between `range`<!-- -->'s two colors; values outside `domain` are clamped to the nearest end rather than extrapolated.
